summary: The cited source adds an inactive export-context codec and journal under the existing host workspace/idempotency key and exclusive owner lock. The immutable context carries the complete original command/binding/reservation/selection, exact manifest bytes, explicit fresh export operation, boot and original monotonic bounds, source/retiring/destination root identity pins. The first source candidate allowed UTF-8 replacement to change malformed string originals and allocated unbounded binding fields before its final size check. The corrected new codecs use strict UTF-8, bounded fields and exact aggregate encoded-size preflight before context serialization, plus bounded context/attempt/journal backing streams; legacy host writer behavior is unchanged. Valid non-ASCII roundtrips exactly; malformed surrogates/UTF-8, oversized fields/aggregate and the exact 65536/65537-byte boundary have focused controls. Exact binary re-encoding and a distinct context-domain SHA256 bind all bytes; checksums and path/device comparisons do not authenticate custody or physical backing. A fresh authenticated host original cannot overwrite any occupied legacy/host/supplier record. One writer-termination-backed attempt is consumed before its bytes return; restart never clears it or renews clocks. Local copy bytes stay opaque and cannot establish durable Export. A future typed receiving verifier must independently authenticate whole host identity/reservation, exact context/attempt/copy digests, destination/manifest, original boot/clock and writer/receiving commit receipts. The private validated observation can update source lifecycle under the same lock, preserving first failure/conflicts. No production verifier, copy/deletion callback, CLI host entry, profile selection or native effect is supplied; the actual Executor refuses the source-only tag. Cold readback retains data without recreating authentication, and file flush/rename/cold equality still report directory durability Unknown. Existing execution/host /1 and supplier /2,/3,/4 grammars remain unchanged; old readers refuse the new source tag, with no read-time upgrade or fabricated clock for old allocations. Source controls cover strict codec joins, false receiving joins, same-lock consumed intent, actual Executor refusal, cold reopen, occupied old-record preservation and five fixed write failure cuts for both initial and attempt records. The containing Execution project is nonpackable; CLI/contract publication, a newly selected coherent version, exact installed consumer adoption, concrete transport/custody/durability and native acceptance remain separate. An ordinary fresh non-destructive owner copy from held old storage must retain its prior Unknown outcomes rather than retroactively construct this original.
title: Strict bounded full export originals and receiving observations share the existing source-only journal
